title: Enhanced detection of artifacts in EEG data using higher-order statistics and independent component analysis

verification.basis: Publisher-provided abstract and indexed bibliographic record; author-hosted manuscript search result corroborates title, authors, journal and pages.

evidence_scope: Simulated artifacts added to actual background EEG; detection in channel versus ICA-component spaces; no muscle-artifact advantage and no direct PROTEUS accuracy evidence.

title: Real-Time Neuroimaging and Cognitive Monitoring Using Wearable Dry EEG

verification.basis: PubMed bibliographic record and primary full-text preprocessing section at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4710679/ verify ASR mechanism and integrated system scope.

evidence_scope: Wearable dry-electrode EEG real-time processing system with ASR; end-to-end classification effects cannot be isolated to ASR.

title: Autoreject: Automated artifact rejection for MEG and EEG data

verification.basis: Indexed title/year/venue/pages and primary full-text methods/validation at https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7243972/; arXiv manuscript corroborates algorithm.

evidence_scope: Automated sensor-specific thresholds, interpolation and epoch rejection; several public MEG/EEG datasets, including evoked-response reconstruction; not a direct cross-person mental-task benchmark.

title: A new method for off-line removal of ocular artifact

verification.basis: PubMed and publisher primary abstract at https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0013469483901359 verify title, authors, year, venue, volume/pages and EMCP mechanism.

evidence_scope: EOG-informed regression correction and ERP fidelity/reliability tests; needs ocular reference and original offline session estimator is not directly causal. PROTEUS prediction input is EEG41 only; EOG/EMG unavailable, so conventional EOG regression cannot be applied directly.

title: Spherical splines for scalp potential and current density mapping

verification.basis: PubMed bibliographic record and primary abstract verify title/year/venue/DOI and mathematical interpolation/current-density contribution.

evidence_scope: Spherical-spline scalp interpolation and current-density approximation; no BCI classification or PROTEUS transfer result in this source.

title: Single-trial analysis and classification of ERP components—A tutorial

verification.basis: Indexed primary abstract and author manuscript https://doc.ml.tu-berlin.de/bbci/publications/BlaLemTreHauMue10.pdf verify shrinkage-LDA framework; journal issue year is 2011, online article 2010.

evidence_scope: Tutorial with methodological demonstrations of shrinkage covariance and ERP single-trial classification; does not establish mental-task cross-person performance.

title: Optimal spatial filtering of single trial EEG during imagined hand movement

verification.basis: Primary journal PDF verified title, all authors, December 2000 volume 8(4), pages 441–446, CSP and three-subject left/right imagery experiment; PMID 11204034.

evidence_scope: Three participants, imagined left versus right hand movement; individual training, not new-person generalization. Journal accurately retained under its historical title.

title: Regularizing common spatial patterns to improve BCI designs: unified theory and new algorithms

verification.basis: PubMed record and primary manuscript https://personal.ntu.edu.sg/ctguan/Publications/2011_Fabien_IEEE_TBME.pdf confirm unified RCSP framework, four new algorithms and 17-subject comparison; journal issue year 2011.

evidence_scope: Comparison of 11 CSP/RCSP algorithms across competition EEG from 17 subjects; regularization benefits vary by method; no zero-calibration PROTEUS claim.

title: Filter Bank Common Spatial Pattern Algorithm on BCI Competition IV Datasets 2a and 2b

verification.basis: Publisher primary full text opened; verifies 2012 volume 6 article 39, all five authors, filter bank/CSP/feature-selection/classification stages and competition datasets.

evidence_scope: Motor imagery BCI Competition IV 2a and 2b; two-class and multiclass constructions, not direct unseen-person PROTEUS validation. Venue exception retained because this is the dedicated established FBCSP paper.

title: Stationary common spatial patterns for brain–computer interfacing

verification.basis: Publisher primary page verifies four authors, publication 20 February 2012, 9(2):026013 and regularization toward stationary subspaces; author manuscript https://iphome.hhi.de/samek/pdf/SamJNE12.pdf corroborates.

evidence_scope: Motor-imagery datasets and analyses of nonstationary feature effects; stationarity can help but is not a guarantee under between-person shift.

title: Spatio-spectral filters for improving the classification of single trial EEG

verification.basis: PubMed primary abstract verifies all four authors, 2005 volume 52(9):1541–1548 and time-delay-embedding extension of CSP; author-hosted manuscript corroborates.

evidence_scope: Imagined limb movement recordings; information transfer per trial compared with standard CSP; not unseen-person evidence.

title: A novel method for reliable and fast extraction of neuronal EEG/MEG oscillations on the basis of spatio-spectral decomposition

verification.basis: PubMed primary abstract plus publisher text https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1053811911000930 verify SSD spectral-contrast mechanism and 2011 volume 55(4):1528–1535.

evidence_scope: Simulations and real resting EEG oscillation extraction; class labels not used and stronger oscillation extraction is not itself proof of classification improvement.

title: SPoC: A novel framework for relating the amplitude of neuronal oscillations to behaviorally relevant parameters

verification.basis: PubMed primary abstract and primary PDF https://pure.mpg.de/rest/items/item_2434502_5/component/file_2621214/content verify seven authors, NeuroImage 86:111–122, continuous-target source-power comodulation; issue year 2014, online 2013.

evidence_scope: Realistic-head simulations and auditory steady-state EEG with sound-intensity target; regression method needs an appropriate continuous target, unavailable in the stated PROTEUS task.

title: Multiclass brain-computer interface classification by Riemannian geometry

verification.basis: Indexed primary abstract verifies 2012 volume 59(4):920–928 and tangent-space LDA alongside MDM; author publication list https://alexandre.barachant.org/papers/short.html corroborates. HAL manuscript indexed but direct opening denied by site protection.

evidence_scope: Multiclass motor-imagery covariance classification using MDM and TSLDA; grouped as one geometric family, with no claim of automatic cross-person invariance or full-target-session reference estimation.

title: Classification of covariance matrices using a Riemannian-based kernel for BCI applications

verification.basis: Author primary publication list confirms four authors, title, 2013 volume 112:172–178 and links publisher/HAL paper; publisher indexed result https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0925231213001574 corroborates abstract. Direct publisher opening returned 403 and HAL download inaccessible; no full-text-open claim.

evidence_scope: Motor-imagery competition dataset, tangent-geometry kernel with SVM compared to alternative kernels; not inherently nonlinear relative to tangent features. Venue exception: Neurocomputing.

title: xDAWN algorithm to enhance evoked potentials: application to brain-computer interface

verification.basis: PubMed and primary PDF https://www.gipsa-lab.grenoble-inp.fr/~bertrand.rivet/references/Rivet2009a.pdf verify title, authors, 2009 volume 56(8):2035–2043 and three-subject P300 evaluation.

evidence_scope: P300 speller, three subjects, spatial enhancement plus Bayesian LDA; PROTEUS cue+1s windows may exclude relevant early event responses.

title: Frequency recognition based on canonical correlation analysis for SSVEP-based BCIs

verification.basis: PubMed primary abstract verifies four authors, 2007 volume 54(6 Pt 2):1172–1176, sinusoidal CCA frequency recognition and FFT comparison; author-hosted PDF corroborates.

evidence_scope: Frequency-coded steady-state visual stimulation; no direct applicability to PROTEUS internal mental tasks without corresponding periodic stimuli.

title: Enhancing Detection of SSVEPs for a High-Speed Brain Speller Using Task-Related Component Analysis

verification.basis: Indexed PubMed primary abstract verifies six authors, 2018 volume 65(1):104–112 and reproducibility-based TRCA; issue year 2018, online 2017. PMC direct opening challenged by browser protection, so no full-text-open claim.

evidence_scope: Offline multiclass SSVEP comparison and online spelling with calibration and stimulus-locked reproducibility; no direct PROTEUS applicability, no transfer of reported ITR/accuracy.
